description: Extract the ATS keywords and requirements in a job posting, with each term's category, importance and must-have flag. Shows must-have versus nice-to-have requirements so the resume can reflect the posting's own language. Requires a connected AI Applyd account and uses the user's AI credits. Do not use it to read a posting from a link; use aiapplyd_get_matches with job_url. Next: aiapplyd_score_resume or aiapplyd_optimize_resume with the same job description.

job_description.description: Full text of the job description
